name: india-stock-market-news
title: Indian Stock Market News | NSE, BSE, Nifty 50, Sensex & Mint
description:
Get the latest stock market news from India's top financial publishers — Economic Times, Mint, and Business Standard — in one structured JSON dataset.

Includes headlines, publication date, article links, detected company tickers (Reliance, TCS, Infosys, HDFC Bank, Nifty 50 stocks, and more), sentiment scores, and event tags (earnings, analyst ratings, M&A, macro). No login required.

**How to use:**
1. Click **Start** — results appear in the Output tab within seconds.
2. Schedule every 15–60 minutes with **Only new articles** enabled to receive only fresh headlines.
3. Connect to Slack, Discord, or Telegram via Apify webhooks or Make/Zapier integrations.

**Covered publishers:** Economic Times Markets, Economic Times Stocks, Livemint Markets, Business Standard Markets.

**Perfect for:** Indian retail investors, algorithmic traders monitoring Nifty 50, FinTech apps needing NSE/BSE news APIs, and AI/RAG pipelines focused on Indian equities.
